subject: Hosted API pricing qualification - token volumes & peak TPS
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finovate.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification - token volumes & peak TPS

Hi Liam — great to speak earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned on pricing/volume before I prepare a formal proposal: 

Recap from today’s call:
- Expected monthly token volume (generation): ~80,000,000 tokens (could grow to 100–120M depending on product adoption)
- Embeddings volume (monthly): ~5,000,000 tokens
- Typical response size (median): ~100–120 tokens/request
- Peak request TPS: ~12 TPS sustained during business hours, with short bursts up to ~30 TPS (you mentioned mornings ET could spike)
- Target unit economics you mentioned: target ~$100 / 1M tokens (budget range $5k–$10k / month, we noted you’d aim for ~$8k/mo)

Key questions for pricing accuracy:
1) Can you confirm the expected split between generation vs embeddings month-to-month?
2) For peak TPS, is 12 TPS the sustained expectation or would you want SLOs for 20 TPS sustained? Any predictable daily window?
3) Any compliance requirements (SOC2, audit logs, HIPAA) we should include in the quote?

Next steps: I’ll draft a ballpark pricing sheet and a short POC proposal (14-day trial with sample traffic profile). I’ve attached a draft proposal (redwood_proposal_v1.pdf) with initial numbers — I’ll update once you confirm the answers above.

If you prefer, let’s lock a 30-min pricing follow-up on Friday to finalize the POC profile.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0143

---
Attachment: redwood_proposal_v1.pdf (proposal stub - pricing tiers & POC scope)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finovate.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification - token volumes & peak TPS

Thanks Ben — quick confirmations here:
- Monthly generation tokens: baseline ~80M, likely 80–120M in Q2 if adoption goes well.
- Embeddings: 3–7M / month.
- Median response size: ~100 tokens.
- Peak TPS: mornings (09:00–11:00 ET) could hit 15–20 TPS sustained for short periods; worst-case bursts ~30 TPS.
- Budget: target $8k / month; we can stretch to ~$12k/mo if performance and reliability justify it.

We need a clear ballpark on $ / 1M tokens and whether you offer discounts at commit tiers. Also confirm whether the trial includes reserved capacity for realistic latency testing (we care about p95 latency at peak). SOC2 compliance is required.

If you can send a short pricing matrix (PAYG, 100M commitment, 3-month trial terms), I’ll share internally and we can schedule the follow-up.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor
Director, AI Product | Finovate
liam.oconnor@finovate.com | +1 617-555-0202

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finovate.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification - token volumes & peak TPS

Appreciate the quick details, Liam — that helps. Ballpark pricing & options (high level):

PAYG (no commit):
- Generation: $120 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings: $45 / 1M tokens

Committed (>=100M tokens / month):
- Generation: $90 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings: $35 / 1M tokens

Introductory offer (proposal): 15% off list pricing for the first 3 months to help you ramp (can be applied to PAYG or the committed tier for the initial period).

Notes & operational considerations:
- Peak TPS & latency: the full-service Hosted API can handle bursts, but for sustained 15–20 TPS with tight p95 latency we typically recommend reserved capacity (Dedicated) or a trial with pre-provisioned concurrency; I’ll have Alex scope the trial config.
- Compliance: Redwood is SOC2 Type II compliant; we can provide the report under NDA and enable audit logging for the POC.
- Trial: we can provide a 14-day POC with pre-warmed trial capacity to reproduce peak windows (I’ll include recommended request profile).

Estimated monthly cost example (baseline 80M gen tokens @ committed pricing):
- Generation: 80 x $90 = $7,200 / month
- Embeddings: 5 x $35 = $175 / month
- Estimated total: ~$7,375 / month (before introductory discount)

I’ve attached an updated proposal with those tiers (redwood_proposal_v1.pdf). If that aligns, next steps are: 1) confirm POC traffic profile (we’ll size trial capacity), 2) legal/POC MSA, 3) schedule kickoff.

Are you free for a 30-min pricing + POC scope call Fri 02/20 at 10:30am ET?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T09:25:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Approve 15% promo for Finovate POC?

Marissa / Alex — looping you both in for quick approval. Finovate (Liam O') is ~80–120M gen tokens potential, embedding ~5M. He’s targeting ~$8k/mo budget and needs a POC that reproduces 15–20 TPS peaks. I proposed the following options to get the deal moving: 

- PAYG list, or committed at 100M/mo (gen $90/1M) with standard terms.
- Offer 15% off list pricing for first 3 months to help them ramp and meet budget expectations.
- Provide a 14-day pre-warmed trial simulating morning ET peaks (Alex to size).

Request: confirm we can extend the 15% intro discount for 90 days and approve trial reserved capacity for the POC. Also confirm if we should include a clause that committed discount only applies after signature of a 3-month minimum.

Thanks — Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Approve 15% promo for Finovate POC?

Ben — approve the 15% introductory discount for the first 3 months. Confirm the following before sending final proposal: 
1) Add standard clause: committed pricing requires a signed commitment of at least 3 months (or pro-rated minimum).
2) Alex: confirm trial node sizing & expected cost to Redwood for pre-warmed capacity so we can disclose approximate support overhead.
3) Loop Legal on the MSA & include the SOC2 NDA link in the related materials.

Once those are confirmed, send the updated proposal to Liam and schedule the Fri call.

— Marissa
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
